note: Go: snapshot.Take, Driver.PutTar(Snapshot.WriteTar) into a run volume, then script in node:24 (debian) with the volume at /data. synthetic is tree.testutil.ts buildSyntheticTree.
script:
cd /data && find . -mindepth 1 | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -L "$p" ]; then echo "symlink $(stat -c '%a %u:%g' "$p") $p -> $(readlink "$p")"
  elif [ -d "$p" ]; then echo "dir $(stat -c '%a %u:%g %Y' "$p") $p"
  else echo "file $(stat -c '%a %u:%g %Y %s' "$p") $(sha256sum < "$p" | cut -d' ' -f1) $p"
  fi
done
